name: Biennale Yellow
avoid_for: Decks that need visual punch or saturated multi-color energy — the warm-paper canvas and one-yellow palette are intentionally quiet and atmospheric
weak_cases: Dense dashboard cells crowd the literary spacing; faint atmosphere is not a data encoding.
visual_signature: Parchment, indigo hairlines, yellow sun bloom and serif/italic hierarchy.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Serif/italic contrast needs an intentional equivalent in other scripts; inspect mixed-script baselines.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
